title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-28 04:27:36 最新章节：第1086章 剑开秘境
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
【当今时代，癌症已经不是致死率百分百的绝症，我们有先进的技术，成熟的医疗团队，只要您有一份保险，或者一个愿意支持您的家庭，再或者您自己……】
陈怀安关了电视机，苦涩一笑：“可我什么都没有。”
病危通知书是前天下的，女友是昨天跑的，人是今天崩的。
他只是个刚入学的大学生，父母是护林员，几年前在一场森林大火中丧生，烧得什么都不剩，只给他留下一笔不怎么可观的赔偿金。
这些年，陈怀安已经从父母的死中走出来，选择积极面对生活。靠着这些赔偿金，省吃俭用，外加打零工，读完大学问题不大。
他的成绩还行，至少上了个一本，据说毕业还包分配工作。想着就算工资低一些至少还能活下去，结果前天去医院检查经常刺痛的脚踝却查了个癌症中期出来。
自知没钱治疗，陈怀安干脆从学校出来，在本市湿地公园附近租了一年的房子，打算在这里度过自己的余生。至于房租到期没钱了怎么办？
呵呵，他觉得自己活不到那个时候。
打开手机查询银行卡余额，还剩下三万多。
“吃饭一个月顶多五六百，算上其他杂七杂八的日常开销就按一千算，一年后起码还有两万。”陈怀安盯着余额一阵琢磨，这几年过得太苦，别的学生到处旅游的时候他在打零工，别的学生玩游戏的时候他在打零工，别的学生谈恋爱的时候……他女朋友在给他戴绿帽。
接下来的时间他打算为自己而活。
玩玩游戏，看看这几年攒下来的电视剧，如果身体条件允许再去海边打个卡。
【安装完成】
【快来领取你的电子女友吧！】
平时看到手机弹出这样的广告陈怀安的第一反应就是忽略，或者划掉。
但今天他的手指却停住了。
来到手机主界面，多了个app图标，是个q版古风人像。
看起来是个女孩，青衣负剑，衣袂飘飘。
“自动安装的游戏？该不会是什么病毒之类的吧……”
放在以前遇到这种情况他直接就是个删除，顺带点开手机管家扫描一下，但他今天倒是有心情看看这些病毒软件到底是怎么个事儿。

如今他一无所有，病入膏肓，光脚的不怕穿鞋的，关键是之前一直忙于打工上学，根本没玩过什么游戏，早就想试试了。
点开app，屏幕黑下去，弹出个提示框。
【本游戏仅允许18岁以上游玩，游戏开始将绑定您的身份，您的账号无法销毁和转赠，开始游戏即认为同意以上霸王条款。】
“哟呵，你也知道这是霸王条款？”
陈怀安无语地撇了撇嘴，点了下开始游戏。
他现在已经百分百确定这就是个病毒软件。
那么对方会做什么呢？盗取身份信息？聊天记录？要是知道他是个癌症中期还没钱治病的倒霉蛋，这app后的操纵者不会主动把app卸载掉吧？
【请选择您的电子女友！】
游戏画面意外的很精致。
app看着是q版古风，但进来看就非常写实了。
眼前展现着十几个可供陈怀安选择的‘电子女友’，他还能看到这些‘电子女友’的基本信息。比如现在陈怀安选择界面的就是：
【霓虹黑道千金：雾岛琴子】
content_en:
[In today's era, cancer is no longer a terminal disease with a 100% fatality rate. We have advanced technology and a mature medical team. As long as you have an insurance, a family willing to support you, or yourself...]
Chen Huaian turned off the TV and smiled bitterly: "But I have nothing."
The critical illness notice was issued the day before yesterday, my girlfriend ran away yesterday, and she died today.
He was just a college student who had just entered school. His parents were forest rangers. He died in a forest fire a few years ago. It burned nothing, leaving him only a modest compensation.
Over the years, Chen Huaian has gotten over the death of his parents and chosen to face life positively. Relying on these compensation funds, living frugally and working part-time jobs, it is not a big problem to finish college.
His grades were pretty good, he had at least passed a bachelor's degree, and it was said that he would be assigned a job after graduation. I thought I could at least survive even if my salary was lower, but the day before yesterday I went to the hospital to check my ankle, which often hurts, and it turned out that I had mid-stage cancer.
Knowing that he had no money for treatment, Chen Huaian simply left school and rented a house near the city's wetland park for a year, planning to spend the rest of his life here. What should I do if I have no money when the rent is due?
Haha, he felt that he would not live until that time.
I turned on my mobile phone to check my bank card balance, and there was more than 30,000 left.
"Eating is at most five or six hundred a month. If we include other miscellaneous daily expenses, we will calculate it as one thousand. After a year, there will be at least twenty thousand." Chen Huaian stared at the balance and thought for a while. The past few years have been too hard. He was doing odd jobs when other students were traveling around, he was doing odd jobs when other students were playing games, and when other students were in love...his girlfriend was cuckolding him.
He plans to live for himself for the rest of his life.
Play games, watch the TV series saved over the past few years, and if your physical condition allows, go to the beach to check in.
[Installation completed]
【Come and get your electronic girlfriend! 】
When Chen Huaian sees such an advertisement popping up on his mobile phone, his first reaction is to ignore it or cross it out.
But today his fingers stopped.
When you come to the main interface of the mobile phone, there is an additional app icon, which is a Q version of an ancient style portrait.
She looks like a girl, wearing green clothes with a sword on her back and fluttering skirts.
"Automatically installed games? Could it be a virus or something..."
In the past, when he encountered this kind of situation, he would just delete it and open the phone manager to scan it. But today, he was in the mood to see what these virus software were about.
Now he has nothing, is terminally ill, and is not afraid of wearing shoes even if he is barefoot. The key is that he has been busy working and going to school before, and has never played any games at all. He has long wanted to try it.
When you click on the app, the screen goes black and a prompt box pops up.
[This game is only allowed to be played by people over 18 years old. Your identity will be bound when the game starts. Your account cannot be destroyed or transferred. Starting the game means you agree to the above Overlord terms. 】
"Oh, you also know that this is the overlord clause?"
Chen Huaian curled his lips speechlessly and clicked to start the game.
He is now 100% sure that this is a virus software.
So what will the other party do? Identity theft? Chat history? If they had known that he was an unlucky guy with mid-stage cancer and no money for treatment, the manipulator behind this app would not have uninstalled the app on his own initiative, right?
【Please choose your electronic girlfriend! 】
The game graphics are surprisingly exquisite.
The app looks like the Q version of the ancient style, but when you look inside, it becomes very realistic.
There were more than a dozen 'electronic girlfriends' for Chen Huaian to choose from, and he could also see the basic information of these 'electronic girlfriends'. For example, the interface Chen Huaian chooses now is:
[Neon Underworld Daughter: Kirishima Kotoko]
